newsitem.title: GERMANY: Martinair delays adding ex-Netherlands surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Martinair delays adding ex-Netherlands surcharge.

text.p: Martinair has still not made a decision on introducing a cargo surcharge from the Netherlands, its Frankfurt-based central Europe cargo sales director, Heiner Sass, said.

The airline faces "a difficult situation" in the Netherlands where angry Dutch shippers have called for a government enquiry into what appeared to be a co-ordinated move by airlines to add the surcharge.
Martinair had earlier introduced a cargo fuel surcharges in Germany, France, Switzerland, Italy and Austria.
"We introduced a surcharge in central Europe of the equivalent of 10 cents from November 11," Sass stated.
The surcharge amounted to 50 centimes in France, 12 centimes in Switzerland, 150 lire in Italy and one schilling in Austria.

The Dutch airline, jointly owned by KLM and Dutch shipping line Nedlloyd added a 15 pfennigs surcharge in Germany with effect from November 4, Sass said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
